freeze_time_basis: Actual execution time when these forecast contents were sealed before exclusive write.

constant.rule: Keep the last observed cumulative count.

observation_policy.selection_rule: First successful same-source numeric read at/after target within the late budget; retain failed/missing reads.
observation_policy.interpretation: Record real observed_at/age/lateness. A delayed read is a target-window proxy, not exact age-3600 truth.
observation_policy.missed_window: Keep late observation separate; exclude from primary60-minute matched-window errors. Do not interpolate or rewrite predictions.

error_contract.scope: Descriptive errors against captured target-window counter; exact60-minute truth remains null for a delayed read.
error_contract.counter_revision: Flag a later counter below the origin; retain raw counts, reconcile before rate conclusions; never clamp to zero.

limitations: Only two reviewed same-post public counter points; no trained, calibrated or generalized content model.
Origin is the real capture end at age1466.922 seconds, not a fabricated15-minute observation; target age remains3600 seconds.
Counters may include operator opens and update asynchronously. Other posts, conversations and account operations run concurrently; follower attribution and exposure origin are unknown.
Two different native posts do not establish independent random samples: the same account and related topics can create dependence.
No torch training/transfer, authorship probabilities or verified Home model/labels are used; prediction intervals and future outcomes are unknown.
Recorded capture completeness and first-read selection are operator declarations, not independent proof that omitted observations do not exist.
Preserve this file unchanged. Record the first successful same-source target-window read and its real age in a separate evaluation; delayed values are proxies, not exact60-minute truth.
capture_hash_basis: Per-capture hashes bind exact raw bytes; top-level aggregate hashes bind the chronological JSON lists of those hashes.
input_selection_rule: Latest two successful same-source numeric captures available by input_cutoff_at; this reviewed history contains exactly these two records. Do not select points after viewing target outcomes.
